Version 0.9.1 includes [PR #23](https://github.com/apoorvalal/crabbymetrics/pull/23):
a corrected synthetic-control optimizer, explicit fixed-effect inference
conventions, and untreated-only fixed-effect imputation.

```bash
pip install --upgrade crabbymetrics==0.9.1
```

## Synthetic control

[`SyntheticControl`](reference/SyntheticControl.qmd) now solves its least-squares
objective directly on the simplex with an active-set quadratic solver. Exact
zero donor weights are allowed. Convergence requires feasibility and KKT checks;
exhausting the iteration budget raises an error instead of returning a
misleading success flag. Summaries expose the objective, iteration count,
feasibility error, normalized KKT residual, and stopping reason.

Previously fitted models should be refitted. In the outcome-only Proposition 99
example, pre-treatment RMSE changes from **2.399913 to 1.656400**, and the mean
post-treatment gap from **−18.998496 to −19.513630**. The corrected values agree
with independent R and SciPy optimizers for the same objective. This remains
outcome-only SCM, not predictor-weighted or augmented SCM.

## Fixed-effect regression

[`FixedEffectsOLS`](reference/FixedEffectsOLS.qmd) adds absorption controls,
FE-only fits, and level prediction for identified one- and two-way effects.
Unknown levels and disconnected combinations are rejected. Three-or-more-way
slope fitting remains supported, but level prediction is not.

Summary and Wald inference accept explicit FE degrees-of-freedom and
small-sample corrections. The existing full-FE default is preserved; examples
show how to match `fixest` and `plm` conventions rather than treating different
corrections as numerical disagreements.

## Fixed-effect imputation

[`FEImputation`](examples/fe-imputation.qmd) estimates additive unit/time
counterfactuals using observed, positive-weight untreated cells only. It accepts
missing observations, treatment reversals, covariates and weights, and exposes
training/evaluation masks and unit/time effect aggregations. Unidentified
counterfactuals and collinear nuisance covariates are rejected.

The class provides **point estimates only**. It does not supply confidence
intervals, justify treatment reversals causally, or implement interactive-factor
or matrix-completion counterfactual estimation.

## Evidence and compatibility

The [implementation report](ablations/yqx-panel-fixes.qmd) records independent
R-generated fixtures, leakage checks and the lecture-data comparisons. The
[original audit](ablations/yqx-panel-lectures.qmd) preserves the pre-fix evidence
and clearly separates saved results from current estimator examples.

The Python runtime dependency remains NumPy. The release workflow tests Python
3.10 and 3.12, builds Linux/macOS wheels for Python 3.10–3.14, and publishes a
source distribution without rendered documentation. See the
[GitHub release](https://github.com/apoorvalal/crabbymetrics/releases/tag/v0.9.1)
and [documentation reproduction guide](reproducing.qmd).
